commands.name: SetContainmentParent
steps: outside lock preview current parent/ancestry
inside UoW require child and proposed parent active/current as applicable
run CONTAINMENT_CYCLE_GUARD_V1 against current rows and reject second-parent/stale state
insert receipt; append set/move/clear event and replace/remove current parent row
audit prior/new edge and commit
rules: does not change Rack placement, Site, Cloud, IP, Model or connectivity

commands.name: CreateCloudType
steps: normalize/show same-name candidates
inside UoW insert receipt/new reusable Cloud Type/audit and commit

commands.name: CreateCloudDeployment
steps: normalize inputs
inside UoW require active Site and Cloud Type
insert receipt/new site-scoped Deployment/audit and commit
commands.rule: Deployment identity is independent and never directly Customer-owned

name: ChangeCloudDeploymentLifecycle
steps: inside UoW archive requires no current Network Element assignments; reactivate requires Site/Cloud Type active
insert receipt/update lifecycle/audit and commit
rule: does not mutate assigned elements by cascade

name: SetCloudDeploymentAssignment
steps: outside lock preview same-Site eligibility
inside UoW re-read element/deployment/current assignment; deployment must be active and deployment.site_id == network_element.site_id
insert receipt/assignment event and replace/remove current row
audit/commit

name: AddNetworkElementIp
steps: normalize with IP_NORMALIZATION_V1 and show cross-element duplicate candidates
inside UoW require active Network Element and no same-element canonical duplicate
if make_primary require explicit primary-reassignment intent when another primary exists
insert receipt/new IP identity/add event/current row; when requested, append unset-primary event/current update for prior primary then set-primary event for new relation
audit duplicate warnings/result refs and commit

name: SetPrimaryNetworkElementIp
steps: inside UoW require target IP active and belongs to Network Element
insert receipt; append unset_primary for prior primary when different and set_primary for target; update both current rows atomically
audit/commit
rule: at most one active primary at commit

name: CorrectNetworkElementIp
steps: normalize new address when applicable
inside UoW revalidate relation/current primary state and same-element duplicates
insert receipt and append address_corrected/remove/reactivate/correction event
update projection; removing current primary clears primary without auto-selecting replacement
audit/commit
rules: IP relation identity/history survives address correction
blank workbook cells never call this command
